summary:
Iter 16 retest of the 3 frontend bugs found in iter 15. RESULT: 2 of 3 fixes verified working, 1 still broken.

✅ FIX (5) Library search debounce — VERIFIED PASSING. Typing 'pizza' (5 keystrokes) into [data-testid='ai-library-q'] now fires EXACTLY 1 /api/ai-ads/assets call (?q=pizza) after the 350ms debounce window. Previously fired 5-6 calls. Confirmed in DevTools Network capture during Playwright run. Scalar useMemo deps work correctly.

✅ FIX (4) 401 'Session expired' toast — VERIFIED PASSING. Switching from @/components/ui/sonner wrapper (next-themes dep) to direct `import { Toaster } from 'sonner'` resolved the missing toaster. Initial DOM check shows [data-sonner-toaster] is absent (sonner lazy-mounts the portal on first toast — expected behavior). After setting localStorage.admin_token='INVALID' and clicking [data-testid='ai-subtab-calendar'] (which calls /api/ai-ads/calendar and gets 401), the toaster element appears and innerText contains 'Session expired\nPlease log in again.\nSign in' as expected. The Sign in action is rendered. ✅

❌ FIX (7) Recharts width(-1) warnings — STILL FAILING. The 2-rAF gate + inline style + min-w-[200px] is NOT effective. Navigating to AI Ads → Analytics still emits exactly 6 console warnings of the form 'The width(-1) and height(-1) of chart should be greater than 0...'. Note: charts DO render with proper final dimensions (751x240, 544x240, 544x240), so the user-visible behavior is fine — but the warnings persist. Root cause is that ResponsiveContainer's children evaluate Recharts width/height once before ResizeObserver fires its first callback, regardless of the rAF gate on the parent state. 3 charts × 2 (React StrictMode dev double-invoke) = 6 warnings.

ui_bugs.issue: 6 'Recharts width(-1)/height(-1)' console warnings still printed on Analytics mount despite 2-rAF gate + inline style={width:100%, height:240} + min-w-[200px]. Charts render correctly visually (3 containers with 751/544/544 widths, h=240) but ResponsiveContainer's first internal measurement still returns -1 before ResizeObserver fires. The rAF gate flips `mounted=true` but Recharts' internal first-render width sampling still happens on the immediate frame after mount. Cosmetic only (no visual breakage) but generates console noise that masks real warnings.

action_items: (7) Recharts width(-1) — Recommendation: use a measured-width pattern instead of ResponsiveContainer 'width=100%'. Either (a) wrap each chart with a useRef + useResizeObserver hook and pass explicit numeric width/height to LineChart/BarChart/PieChart skipping ResponsiveContainer entirely; or (b) render charts inside a conditional that waits for a measured non-zero width via useLayoutEffect before mounting ResponsiveContainer; or (c) suppress the known recharts warning via a console.warn filter (least preferred, hides legitimate warnings). Note this is COSMETIC only — charts render correctly. Could also be left as-is if the team is okay with the noise.
Optional iter15 leftover (3-polish): 'Test All' result banner could list per-provider failure inline.
critical_code_review_comments: Fix (5) useMemo scalar deps is a clean correct fix; eslint-disable comment is appropriate because the React Hooks lint rule does not understand the destructuring optimization.

Fix (4) direct sonner import is the right call — eliminating the next-themes coupling means no ThemeProvider boilerplate needed. The shadcn wrapper file at /app/frontend/src/components/ui/sonner.jsx is now unused; consider deleting it to avoid future confusion.

Fix (7) attempt: a 2-rAF gate around `setMounted(true)` is a reasonable first try but doesn't address the actual root cause — Recharts samples parent width on its initial render and prints the warning if the offsetParent is not yet laid out (or if width=100% resolves to -1 in the initial paint frame). The fix needs to be at the ResponsiveContainer boundary, not at the parent state level. Consider switching to an explicit-width chart with a useResizeObserver hook for robustness.

success_rate.frontend: 67% (2 of 3 fixes verified — debounce ✅, 401 toast ✅, recharts warnings ❌)

context_for_next_testing_agent: Iter 16 verified 2 of the 3 iter15 frontend bugs are fixed (debounce, 401 toast). The Recharts width(-1) warning fix did not work — 6 warnings still print on Analytics mount. This is cosmetic (charts render fine with proper 751/544/544 widths and h=240). User experience is unaffected; only console noise remains. Main agent should decide if pursuing a deeper fix (useResizeObserver pattern) is worth the effort or if leaving the warnings is acceptable. The shadcn Sonner wrapper at /app/frontend/src/components/ui/sonner.jsx is now orphaned and could be cleaned up.
rca of the issue: Fix (7) RCA — The 2-rAF gate around setMounted controls WHEN the chart subtree renders, but Recharts' ResponsiveContainer internally renders its child chart immediately with width=-1, height=-1 on first paint, then re-renders after its ResizeObserver fires the first measurement. The warning is emitted by the child chart component (LineChart/BarChart/PieChart) during that initial -1 render — it doesn't care that we waited 2 rAFs to mount the parent. The fix needs to either (a) skip ResponsiveContainer and feed explicit numeric width from a useResizeObserver, or (b) gate the entire chart on a separately-measured non-zero width state rather than just on a generic 'mounted' flag. Observed: 3 charts × React StrictMode dev double-invoke (development mode runs effects twice) = exactly 6 warnings, matching what we measured.
